title: CspComplaint (append-only; sync op csp.complaint, tier T1)
description: A complaint the CSP tells the DC at the shop; the DC writes it in the app (0.20.0+). Read by the Eko team on the dashboard Complaints tab.

id.description: Client UUIDv7. Idempotency key: resends are duplicates, never conflicts.

location_id.description: The CSP the complaint is about.

category.description: DEVICE = machine/device problem, PAYMENT = settlement/money stuck, COMMISSION = commission/charges, SUPPORT = Eko helpline/RM not responding, TRAINING = needs training, OTHER.

fix.description: Where the DC was when writing it. Logged, never gated (ADR-0004).
